nodes.label: Backend CI job (pytest, PostGIS + Redis services)
nodes.rationale: Backend pytest cannot run on host without GDAL/GEOS; CI spins PostGIS and Redis as services and installs gdal-bin/libgdal-dev/libgeos-dev.
nodes.norm_label: backend ci job (pytest, postgis + redis services)

nodes.label: web-admin CI job (npm ci + lint + unit + build)
nodes.rationale: Build does not call the backend; NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL is a placeholder for public variables.
nodes.norm_label: web-admin ci job (npm ci + lint + unit + build)

nodes.label: PostGIS 16 (postgis/postgis:16-3.4) service
nodes.rationale: Backend tests require PostGIS in CI, mirroring the dts-postgis container used for local dev.

nodes.label: Redis 7 (redis:7-alpine) service
nodes.rationale: Backend tests need Redis (Celery broker / Channels layer) up, same as local docker-infrastructure.

nodes.label: GDAL/GEOS system dependencies
nodes.rationale: Backend cannot run outside Docker without GDAL installed; CI verifies GDAL bindings early with a Django GIS import check.

nodes.label: Backend realtime smoke tests (push, chat, tracking, WS Origin)
nodes.rationale: Runs a targeted subset (order signals, notifications, chat, WS origin, tracking destination, radius/work zone) before the full suite to fail fast on realtime regressions.
nodes.norm_label: backend realtime smoke tests (push, chat, tracking, ws origin)

nodes.label: Recursive submodule checkout (actions/checkout)
nodes.rationale: Root CI checks out the four independent project submodules (backend, web-admin, flutter-customer, flutter-driver) recursively because each project is a separate Git repo.

nodes.label: Customer WS URI smoke test (env_ws_uri_test.dart)
nodes.rationale: Fast realtime sanity check on the WebSocket URI env wiring before the full Flutter test suite.

nodes.label: Driver WS URI + offers smoke tests
nodes.rationale: Scoped smoke run covers realtime WS URI wiring plus the offers feature before the full suite.
nodes.norm_label: driver ws uri + offers smoke tests

nodes.label: web-admin submodule CI (lint + unit + build)
nodes.rationale: Build does not call the backend; NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL is just a placeholder for public variables.

nodes.label: Web-admin E2E Playwright job (commented-out)
nodes.rationale: E2E requires E2E_BASE_URL plus demo merchant credentials as GitHub secrets; job stays commented out until those secrets exist (see docs/CI_GITHUB_ACTIONS.md in monorepo).

nodes.label: web-admin feature structure (components/hooks/api/types)
nodes.rationale: Per-module vertical slice: components + hooks + api.ts typed fetch functions + types.ts DTOs aligned with DRF serializers; no invented fields.

nodes.label: DTS API client (lib/api/client.ts, Bearer auth)
nodes.rationale: Single fetch wrapper using NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL + Authorization Bearer from cookie/context; throws ApiError on non-OK.

nodes.label: Typed DTOs (types.ts) aligned with DRF serializers
nodes.rationale: Interfaces reflect the API response shape without inventing fields; no business logic duplicated in frontend (state transitions and discounts stay in backend).
nodes.norm_label: typed dtos (types.ts) aligned with drf serializers

nodes.label: Playwright E2E specs for web-admin
nodes.rationale: Test names snake_case follow TASKS.md; prefer the test backend or MSW in CI over mocking the API unless the test demands it.

nodes.label: Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM)
nodes.rationale: Driven by FCM_CREDENTIALS_PATH service-account.json; firebase-admin used in fcm_client and mocked in backend tests.

nodes.label: notifications feature (NotificationType, OrderStatusNotificationMapper, send_push)
nodes.rationale: Domain holds NotificationType + PushTemplate and OrderStatusNotificationMapper; infrastructure holds fcm_client, send_push_task (Celery) and optional NotificationLog; mock firebase_admin.messaging.send and FirebaseMessaging (mocktail) in tests.

nodes.label: Order status change -> push signal pattern
nodes.rationale: Django post_save receiver on OrderModel dispatches dispatch_order_push_task.delay on status change, keeping push decoupled from the save path.
nodes.norm_label: order status change -> push signal pattern

nodes.label: POST /api/v1/accounts/device-token/ (device registration)
nodes.rationale: Flutter app registers its FCM token after successful login so the backend can target push to the right device.

nodes.label: Flutter web bootstrap (flutter_bootstrap.js, $FLUTTER_BASE_HREF)
nodes.rationale: Standard Flutter web entry: base href replaced by --base-href at build time, PWA manifest + apple-mobile-web-app meta, flutter_bootstrap.js async loader.

nodes.label: Xcode Assets.xcassets launch screen customization
nodes.rationale: Customize iOS launch screen by replacing images in this directory or dragging assets onto Assets.xcassets inside the Runner.xcworkspace.

nodes.label: Django REST API (/api/v1/)
nodes.rationale: Single frontend entry point consumed by web-admin and Flutter apps; Swagger at :8000/api/v1/docs/.
